title: Add Request Validation to an Endpoint
summary: Harden a registration endpoint with explicit validation and ProblemDetails responses.
objectives: Translate a field contract into explicit validation rules.
Return a consistent validation response for invalid input.
Keep validation close to the endpoint that owns the request.
constraints: Return 201 Created for a valid request.
Return 400 Bad Request with field-level errors for invalid input.
Do not accept an invalid request and store it anyway.
Keep the route and request record unchanged.
